statement: NVIDIA guided Vera Rubin to about 20% of data-center revenue in Q3 FY2027 and described it as the fastest product ramp in the company's history.
why: A brand-new platform reaching a fifth of data-center revenue in its first full quarter shows customers are absorbing the new generation immediately, not waiting.

impact.mechanism: A steep Vera Rubin ramp pulls forward HBM, advanced packaging and rack-scale system demand while lifting NVIDIA's own guided data-center revenue mix.

evidence.source: Investing.com earnings call transcript (NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
evidence.excerpt: we expect Vera Rubin to account for about 20% of data center revenue in Q3.

confidence.basis: Third-party transcript of the official earnings call; guidance stated as a share of revenue, not a dollar amount, so no dollar value is recorded.
